integrity: Original asymptotic and localization claim rests on an analytic proof. Classical unit-cycle Green kernels, rank-one resolvent updates, and median duality are not asserted to be original. Computational checks are finite and independent bibliographic or mathematical review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive edge conductance, real mean-zero forcing, unnormalized finite-cycle Laplacians. No uniform limit is claimed as the defective conductance approaches zero with the cycle size. Finite maximizers for strengthened conductance are not completely classified. Literature priority remains provisional.
title: A quarter-cycle amplification law for a single weak conductance edge
